message: Unlock enterprise-grade features this summer! Upgrade to our Enterprise plan before July 31st and get 3 months free. Includes unlimited API access, priority support, and advanced analytics.

Introducing Smart Reports! Generate beautiful, AI-powered reports in one click. Available now for all plan levels. Try it out from your dashboard under Reports > Smart Reports.
